Have you applied to Seedlings?

If you have not completed the application process yet please start HERE

If you have been offered a specific spot in a Seedlings session please complete this enrollment form.

Once you submit this form, you will receive a confirmation email from Seedlings@SunflowerCreativeArts.org. If you do not receive an email within 2 hours please let us know.
